GSE81682.observations: Mouse hematopoietic stem/progenitor Smart-seq2 counts with index-sorting measurements and ERCC spike-ins.
GSE81682.source_scope: GEO lists 3840 samples; the Bioconductor 3.19 workflow starts from 1920 cells and 46078 endogenous genes, and retains 1656 cells after its QC. These are different processing scopes, not interchangeable counts.
important_semantics: The documented object has ERCC and FACS alternative experiments, cell metadata and a precomputed diffusion representation.
The documented workflow reports no mitochondrial transcripts; do not fabricate a mitochondrial QC signal.
Keep biological observations and index-sorting identities separate from precomputed analysis labels/embeddings.
Clustering and marker summaries do not create biological replicates for population-level inference.
GSE81682.benchmark_screening: No exact GSE81682/Nestorowa or source DOI suffix in the permitted versioned task metadata at 0c24c094ee. This is incomplete source-lineage evidence, not certified independence.
remaining_checks: Reconcile additional Rep records and donor/pool identities before any donor-aware inference; current QC may use observed cell identities only.
Retain the reviewed GEO use/distribution policy and study attribution; verify annotation versions and exact benchmark input-lineage exclusions.
Retain real counts and spike-ins in connected offline workflows; obtain and reconcile original FACS data before using fine cell annotations.

semantics: GEO counts are imported sparsely; HTSeq __ rows become cell-level mapping metrics; ERCC rows become a separate assay.
Original author website metadata is matched by cell identity; missing FACS observations remain missing. Gate assignments are inferred from cell-name prefixes by the package maintainer.
The 2024-04-18 revision changes the FACS container class; its preparation script states that observations are unchanged.
preparation_evidence.reference_genome: GRCm38 (preparation metadata; exact gene annotation release still unverified)
preparation_evidence.retrieval: scRNAseq::fetchDataset("nestorowa-hsc-2016", "2024-04-18"); run on reserved CPUs and freeze retrieved file hashes before recipe admission

direct_geo_metadata_review.scope: Initial bounded header and series-metadata inspection; the later full count download and exact sparse conversion are recorded in sparse_preparation.
scientific_decisions: The original count header has 1920 unique cell columns. GEO also includes 1920 sample titles with Rep in their cell label; their relationship to the count matrix needs explicit reconciliation before combining records.
The GEO broad sorting groups are HSPC, LT-HSC and Prog. They are not the retrospectively assigned fine cell types from the author FACS tables.
GEO reports mm10, GSNAP 2015-09-29 and unstranded HTSeq 0.5.3p3 counting; the exact gene-annotation release remains unverified.
Cell-level counts and ERCC controls must remain distinct from HTSeq rows beginning with double underscores. Missing author FACS measurements must not be fabricated.

donor_metadata_review.geo_record: All 3840 GEO sample records have the same extraction description: 20 mice aged 8-12 weeks. The retained characteristics identify cell gate, strain and age only; no donor or pool assignment is supplied.
donor_metadata_review.paper_methods: The published Methods describe 10 female 12-week-old mice over two days; each day used one four-mouse pool and one individually analyzed mouse.
donor_metadata_review.decision: The deposit and paper describe different donor scopes. Neither count supports assigning donors to the 1920 count columns; reconcile provenance before any donor-aware inference. Rep sample names alone do not establish biological or technical replication.

preparation.transformation: All original count values and cell/feature order preserved; HTSeq metrics moved to cell metadata.
preparation.limits: Broad sorting gates are not fine cell annotations or biological replicate identifiers. No FACS measurements, embeddings or gene symbols inferred.

sparse_preparation.memory_scope: The worker reports a cumulative peak across child processes; its 1,201,416 KiB peak includes the earlier corpus build and is not an isolated preparation measurement.
sparse_preparation.limits: This validates source preservation, not a single-cell training recipe, donor assignment, source independence or biological inference.

redistribution_review.finding: NCBI imposes no GEO data use or distribution restrictions and describes public release as permitting access, download and reuse. Its policy preserves any submitter intellectual-property claims. No dataset-specific restriction was found in the inspected GSE81682 series record; do not relabel the observations CC0 or infer the dataset licence from the paper copyright.
redistribution_review.attribution: Nestorowa et al., Blood (2016), doi:10.1182/blood-2016-05-716480; GSE81682.
redistribution_review.scope: Original GEO counts and metadata; does not license copying the article, figures, author-website assets or benchmark fixtures.

qc_preparation.policy: Explicit descriptive cell and gene filtering; no donor, fine cell-type or mitochondrial assignments inferred. Counts are read counts, not UMIs.
